examples.text: sotatto sosinno c'eva, eko bhiṃsanake vane, naggo na c'aggim'āsīno, esanāpasuto munī'ti.

examples.text: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.
so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ, dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cā'ti, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.

aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na sotaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me sotanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.
amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan'ti idaṃ pana aṭṭhadosavimuttattā sotapaṭipannassa dārukkhandhassa apare samuddapattiyā antarāyakare aṭṭha dose dassetuṃ ārabhi.

yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti

examples.text: tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhavedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca?

sotasamphassapaccaya + ā

65223.commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tav'eva, pāpima, sotaṃ, tava saddā, tava sotasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. yattha ca kho, pāpima, n'atthi sotaṃ, n'atthi saddā, n'atthi sotasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ, agati tava tattha, pāpima. tav'eva, pāpima, ghānaṃ, tava gandhā, tava ghānasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ.

cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

65226.meaning1: who can hear; who has ears; endowed with hearing

examples.text: apārutā tesaṃ amatassa dvārā, ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ, vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ na bhāsiṃ, dhammaṃ paṇītaṃ manujesu brahme'ti.

65227.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāya-viññāṇāni.

examples.text: sotaviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvi yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo sotaviññāṇassa aññathābhāvi uppādāya so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvi.
cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sotaviññāṇaṃ ghānaviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ

65231.meaningLit: to be known by the ear
65231.commentary: (DNa) cakkhuviññeyyā'ti cakkhuviññāṇena passitabbā. eten'upāyena sotaviññeyy'ādīsu'pi attho veditabbo.

examples.text: ye te sotaviññeyyā saddā assutā assutapubbā, na ca suṇāsi, na ca te hoti suṇeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
sotaviññeyyā saddā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā
ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti
odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ, amatam'adhigataṃ, aham'anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.

65233.commentary: (ANa) sot'ānugatānan'ti pasādasotaṃ odahitvā ñāṇasotena vavatthapitānaṃ (ANa) sot'ānugatā hontī'ti sotaṃ anuppattā anupaviṭṭhā honti.

examples.text: sot'ānugatānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ, vacasā paricitānaṃ, manas'ānupekkhitānaṃ, diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā. katame cattāro?

65235.meaning1: stream entry; first stage of the path
65235.commentary: (DHPa) sot'āpattiphalaṃ varan'ti yasmā ettake ṭhāne rajjaṃ kāretvā'pi niray'ādīhi amutto'va hoti, sot'āpanno pana pihit'āpāyadvāro hutvā sabbadubbalo'pi aṭṭhame bhave na nibbattati, tasmā sot'āpattiphalam'eva varaṃ uttaman'ti attho.

examples.text: pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.
tattha katamaṃ āpatti no adhikaraṇaṃ? sotāpatti samāpatti, ayaṃ āpatti no adhikaraṇaṃ.
pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.
abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.

65237.meaning1: personal experience of the fruit of stream entry; personal realization of the fruition of stream entry

examples.text: evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgatassa kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa dhammatā susamanniṭṭhā hoti sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya. evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sot'āpattiphala-samannāgato hotī'ti.

65238.meaning1: possessing the fruit of stream entry; having the fruition of stream entry

examples.text: evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgatassa kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa dhammatā susamanniṭṭhā hoti sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya. evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sot'āpattiphala-samannāgato hotī'ti.

65239.meaningLit: discourse on the fruit of entering the stream

65241.meaning2: certainty of the path of stream entry

65242.commentary: (SNa) sotāpattiyaṅgehī'ti duvidhaṃ sot'āpattiyā aṅgaṃ, (sot'āpattiyā ca aṅgaṃ) yaṃ pubbabhāge sot'āpattipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati, sappurisasaṃsevo saddhammassavanaṃ yonisomanasikāro dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipattī'ti (dī. ni. 3.311) evaṃ āgataṃ, paṭiladdhaguṇassa ca sotāpattiṃ patvā ṭhitassa aṅgaṃ, yaṃ sot'āpannassa aṅgan'ti'pi vuccati, buddhe aveccappasād'ādīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. idam'idha adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: yato kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, catūhi ca sotāpatti'y'aṅgehi samannāgato hoti
sabbā'pi āpattiyo hīnā. apica, sot'āpattisamāpatti ukkaṭṭhā.

65245.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Diṭṭhisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

65246.meaning2: who has entered the stream of Path

examples.text: sant'ettha, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo sot'āpannā, santi sakadāgāminiyo, santi anāgāminiyo. sabbā tā, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo anipphalā kālaṅ'katā'ti.
yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ pajānāti evaṃ passati, ayaṃ vuccati, sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.

65247.meaning1: stream entry; first stage of the path

examples.text: imehi khv'āhaṃ, mahānāma, tīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sot'āpannapuggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.

65250.meaning1: who are stream-enterers and once returners

65255.meaning1: field of the ear; auditory sphere

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ.
cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ sot'āyatanaṃ ghān'āyatanaṃ jivh'āyatanaṃ kāy'āyatanaṃ man'āyatanaṃ

65256.commentary: (ANa) etadatthā upanisā'ti ohitasoto saupaniso'ti evaṃ vuttā upanisā'pi etadatthā'y'eva. etadatthaṃ sot'āvadhānan'ti tassā upanisāya sot'āvadhānaṃ, tam'pi etadattham'eva.

examples.text: etadatthā, bhikkhave, kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sot'āvadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho'ti.
tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjissāma, rakkhissāma sot'indriyaṃ, sot'indriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjissāma
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti. katamāni pañca? cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.

65258.meaning1: restraint of the sense of hearing

65259.meaning1: with the sense of hearing restrained

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.

65260.meaning1: wanting to hear; wishing to listen (to)

examples.text: purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ
evaṃ kir'assa ahosi, saddhā tāva dhammaṃ sotu'kāmā gamissanti'y'eva, assaddhā'pi pana dhanalobhena gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā dukkhato muccissantī'ti.

65261.meaning2: desire to hear; longing to listen

65262.meaning1: wants to listen (to); wishes to hear

examples.text: loke dukkhaparetasmiṃ, jarāmaraṇasaṃyute, jarāmaraṇamokkhāya, yaṃ dhammaṃ abhisambudhaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ sotum'icchāmi, tuṇhī hohi punabbasū'ti.
dassanakāmo sīlavataṃ, saddhammaṃ sotum'icchati, vinaye maccheramalaṃ, sa ve saddho'ti vuccatī'ti.
cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.

andhabālapitaraṃ nissāya evarūpaṃ buddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ vā kātuṃ dānaṃ vā dātuṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ n'ālatthaṃ, idāni me hatthā'pi anadhipateyyā, aññaṃ kattabbaṃ n'atthī'ti manam'eva pasādesi.

65265.commentary: (MNa) sottisinānin'ti sinān'atthāya katasottiṃ. sotti nāma kuruvindapāsāṇacuṇṇāni lākhāya bandhitvā kataguḷikakalāpakā vuccati, yaṃ sandhāya, tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kuruvindakasuttiyā nahāyantī'ti (cūḷava. 243) vuttaṃ. taṃ ubhosu antesu gahetvā sarīraṃ ghaṃsanti. (MNt) nhānacuṇṇena suttena katā sotti, kuruvindaguḷikā, sā eva sināyanti kāyaṃ visodhenti etāyā'ti sinānaṃ. ten'āha, sotti sinānan'ti sinān'atthāya katasottin'ti.

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, ghaṭikāro ca kumbhakāro jotipālo ca māṇavo sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ agamaṃsu sināyituṃ.
kathañ'ca, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti? sottiñ'ca paṭicca, cuṇṇañ'ca paṭicca, udakañ'ca paṭicca, purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.

65266.meaning1: learned Brahman; one well versed in the Vedas

65266.notes: (MW) mfn. learned in the veda, conversant with sacred knowledge. m a Brahman versed in the veda, theologian, divine.

examples.text: kiṃ pattinam'āhu sottiyaṃ, ariyaṃ kena kathañ'ca caraṇavā'ti. paribbājako kin'ti nāma hoti, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
yo ca jātisataṃ gacche, sabbā brāhmaṇajātiyo, sottiyo vedasampanno, manussesu punappunaṃ.

65268.commentary: (MNa) sottisinānin'ti sinān'atthāya katasottiṃ. sotti nāma kuruvindapāsāṇacuṇṇāni lākhāya bandhitvā kataguḷikakalāpakā vuccati, yaṃ sandhāya, tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kuruvindakasuttiyā nahāyantī'ti (cūḷava. 243) vuttaṃ. taṃ ubhosu antesu gahetvā sarīraṃ ghaṃsanti.

examples.text: evaṃ sammā'ti kho, ānanda, jotipālo māṇavo ghaṭikārassa kumbhakārassa paccassosi. atha kho, ānanda, ghaṭikāro ca kumbhakāro jotipālo ca māṇavo sottisinānaṃ ādāya nadiṃ agamaṃsu sināyituṃ.

65269.meaning2: perfumed soap for washing the body
65269.commentary: (MNa) sottisinānin'ti sinān'atthāya katasottiṃ. sotti nāma kuruvindapāsāṇacuṇṇāni lākhāya bandhitvā kataguḷikakalāpakā vuccati, yaṃ sandhāya, tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kuruvindakasuttiyā nahāyantī'ti (cūḷava. 243) vuttaṃ. taṃ ubhosu antesu gahetvā sarīraṃ ghaṃsanti.

examples.text: kiṃ pana tena muṇḍakena samaṇakena diṭṭhenā'ti? tena hi, samma jotipāla, sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gamissāma sināyitun'ti.
jaggaṃ na saṅke na'pi bhemi sottuṃ, rattin'divā n'ānutapanti māmaṃ, hāniṃ na passāmi kuhiñci loke, tasmā supe sabbabhūt'ānukampī'ti.

sotthi + ana
65271.commentary: (ANa) sotthānaṃ samparāyikan'ti sotthibhūtaṃ samparāyikaṃ. (SNPa) sotthānan'ti sotthibhāvaṃ, sabbesaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ sobhanānaṃ sundarānaṃ kalyāṇānaṃ dhammānam'atthitan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: saddhā sīlena sampannā, vadaññū vītamaccharā, niccaṃ maggaṃ visodheti, sotthānaṃ samparāyikaṃ.
bahū devā manussā ca, maṅgalāni acintayuṃ, ākaṅkhamānā sotthānaṃ, brūhi maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

65272.commentary: (THIa) sotthi siyā brahmacārinī'ti seṭṭhacārini mahesike tuyhaṃ ārogyam'eva bhaveyya.

examples.text: āsādiya edisaṃ janaṃ, aggiṃ pajjalitaṃ va liṅgiya, gaṇhiya āsīvisaṃ viya, api nu sotthi siyā khamehi no.
sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.
koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sotthijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

65275.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sotthi
65275.construction:
su > so + √as + ti + inā
sotthi + inā
65275.commentary: (JAa) sotthin'āmhi samuṭṭhito'ti sotthinā sukhena uṭṭhito amhi bhavāmi.

examples.text: yasmiṃ c'assā padese ṭhitāya evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti tañ'ca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.
sāmoham'asmi bhaddaṃ vo, sotthinā-amhi samuṭṭhito, mā bāḷhaṃ paridevetha, mañjun'ābhivadetha maṃ.
so aparena samayena tamhā kantārā nitthareyya sotthinā abbhayena

65277.commentary: (JAa) sa sotthibhāvo mahatā bhayena me'ti so mayhaṃ ayaṃ ajja mahatā bhayena rakkhasīnaṃ santikā pattabbena dukkhadomanassena sotthibhāvo khemabhāvo pītisomanassabhāvo'y'eva jāto'ti.

examples.text: mayam'eva, bho gotama, dhaṃsī, mayaṃ pagabbā, ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha. siyā hi, bho gotama, hatthiṃ pabhinnaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tv'eva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.
kusal'ūpadese dhitiyā daḷhāya ca, anivattitattā-bhayabhīrutāya ca, na rakkhasīnaṃ vasam'āgamimhase, sa sotthibhāvo mahatā bhayena me'ti.
tatra, gahapatayo, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, sace kho n'atthi hetu, evam'ayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sotthim'attānaṃ karissati.

65279.meaning1: learned Brahman; one well versed in sacred knowledge; theologian

examples.text: kathaṃ kho brāhmaṇo hoti, kathaṃ bhavati vedagū, tevijjo bho kathaṃ hoti, sotthiyo kin'ti vuccati.
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ hantvā, rājāno dve ca sotthiye, veyagghapañcamaṃ hantvā, anīgho yāti brāhmaṇo.

65281.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sotthi
65281.construction:
su > so + √as + ti + iṃ
sotthi + iṃ
65281.commentary: (DHPa) dūrato sotthimāgatan'ti vaṇijjaṃ vā rājaporisaṃ vā katvā laddhalābhaṃ nipphannasampattiṃ anupaddavena dūraṭṭhānato āgataṃ.

examples.text: cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
etādisāni katvāna, sabbatthamaparājitā, sabbattha sotthiṃ gacchanti, taṃ tesaṃ maṅgalam'uttaman'ti.

65282.commentary: (VINt) idāni pariharaṇavidhiṃ dassetuṃ pattaṃ na paṭisāmeyya sodakan'ti-ādi āraddhaṃ. sodakaṃ (cūḷava. 254) pattaṃ na paṭisāmeyya, ātape ca sodakaṃ pattaṃ na otapeti adhippāyo.

examples.text: sace upajjhāyo gāmaṃ pavisitu'kāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṅghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto sodako dātabbo.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sodakaṃ pattaṃ paṭisāmenti. patto dussati.

65283.meaning1: uterine; born of the same mother; sibling
65283.construction:
sa + ud + √dar + a + iya
sodara + iya
65283.commentary: (JAa) sodariyā'ti samāne udare vutthabhāvena te ālapanto āha. (APt) samānodare ṭhito sodariyo, samānassa so.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idh'āssu dve māṇavakā bhātaro sodariyā, eko ajjhāyako upanīto eko anajjhāyako anupanīto. kam'ettha brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā'ti?
sukassa bhāsamānassa, na nisāmetha paṇḍitā, idaṃ suṇātha sodariyā, amhevāyaṃ pasaṃsati.
kiṃ sundarikā karissati, kiṃ payāgo kiṃ bāhukā nadī, veriṃ katakibbisaṃ naraṃ, na hi naṃ sodhaye pāpakamminaṃ.

65290.meaning2: having caused to clean or correct

examples.text: app'ossukko tvaṃ, mahārāja, vīthiyo sodhāpetvā… saparijano uposathaṃ samādiyitvā… sāyanhasamaye mahānāgavan'uyyān'ābhimukho yāhi addhā tasmiṃ ṭhāne dhātuyo lacchasī'ti

tassa heṭṭhābhāgaṃ sodhāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā dhajapaṭākaṃ ussāpetvā vanappatiṃ alaṅ'karitvā añjaliṃ karitvā, sace puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā labheyyaṃ, tumhākaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karissāmī'ti patthanaṃ katvā pakkāmi.

65293.meaning1: should be cleaned; should be purified; should be sorted out

examples.text: sace me gataṭṭhāne dhītu doso uppajjati, tumhehi sodhetabbo.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.
iti kho, ambaṭṭha, n'eva tvaṃ isi na isitthāya paṭipanno sācariyako. yassa kho pana, ambaṭṭha, mayi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā so maṃ pañhena, ahaṃ veyyākaraṇena sodhissāmī'ti.
adaṃsu te mam'okāsaṃ, sodhetuṃ añjasaṃ tadā, buddho buddho'ti cintento, maggaṃ sodhem'ahaṃ tadā.
tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo
parikappe saṇṭhātī'ti, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī'ti kaṇṭhaṃ sodhento, tvaṃ imaṃ nāma pucchissasī'ti vutte, āma, etaṃ'y'eva pucchissāmī'ti vadati.
